explanation: Teotihuacan, near modern Mexico City, was one of the largest cities in the world around AD 500. The Aztecs found it in ruins and gave it its name.

claims.text: Teotihuacan's Pyramid of the Sun was built by around AD 200.
The Western Roman Empire fell in AD 476, when Romulus Augustulus was deposed.
Around AD 500 Teotihuacan was one of the largest cities in the world.
The Aztecs found Teotihuacan already in ruins and gave it its Nahuatl name.
